recentItems.description:
A state-of-the-art Model Anganwadi Center built with modern facilities was inaugurated in Agraharam, Pithapuram of Kakinada district. Apollo Foundation Vice Chairperson Upasana Kamineni and former Union Minister Smriti Irani jointly inaugurated this inspiring facility. Aimed at providing quality education, nutrition, and holistic development for children, Upasana stated that Apollo Foundation plans to expand these initiatives in alignment with AP Deputy CM Pawan Kalyan’s vision for women's empowerment and skill development.
